title: maxChanges: negative integer silently becomes no-limit across all changes handlers
description: All */changes and */queryChanges handlers use v.as_u64() to parse maxChanges/maxChanges. as_u64() returns None for negative values, which is treated as 'no limit'. A client sending maxChanges:-1 (invalid per RFC) gets unlimited results silently. RFC 8620 requires rejecting invalid argument types. Affects: email.rs:108, thread.rs:84, identity.rs:80, mailbox.rs:89, submission.rs:100.
